method_notes: The attached thesis proposal specifies 20 events, while this requested dataset contains 30. If all 30 are used, update the proposal and experimental run count accordingly.
Descriptions use individually specified information cutoffs. The event itself and facts already available by that cutoff are inputs, not forecast targets.
Restatements of information already supplied, including announced plans and official forecasts, should not be credited as newly generated supported predictions.
Announced plans, proposals, guidance and official projections are attributed as such; future scheduled implementation is not presented as a completed outcome.
The selection period is after the March 2026 model-upload dates listed in the proposal. Upload dates are not verified training-data cutoffs. Record immutable model revisions and hashes.

The July 17 selection endpoint leaves at least three calendar months before compilation. This does not establish an observation window; preregister the evaluation horizon before generation or marking.
Events share countries, institutions, energy shocks and other background. Treating all 30 as statistically independent would be inappropriate.
Give each event a fresh independent prompt context. Later event inputs can contain developments that are future outcomes of earlier events.

Sources support event inputs and prior context. This companion file does not provide labels or subsequent outcome evidence. Preserve source snapshots and adjudicate ambiguous or changed web pages before freezing the experimental dataset.
Numbering groups related subjects for navigation and is not a chronological order or a random experimental order.
